chunks: And Ismāʿīl ibn Muslim narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he said:

“Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to one of His prophets: ‘Tell the believers not to wear the clothing of My enemies, not to eat the foods of My enemies, and not to follow the ways of My enemies, lest they become My enemies just as they are My enemies.’”

key_terms.أَعْدَائِي: My enemies; those opposed to Allah
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers; those who possess iman
key_terms.مَسَالِكَ: paths, ways, or modes of conduct
key_terms.نَبِيٍّ: a prophet; one chosen to receive revelation

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about imitating the enemies of Allah in clothing, food, and behavior?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a divine instruction to the believers to avoid adopting the distinguishing ways of Allah’s enemies in dress, food, and conduct. Its significance lies in preserving the moral and spiritual identity of the believers and warning against imitation that leads to alignment with falsehood.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.770 - Ismail ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:

"Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to one of His prophets, saying:
'Tell the believers not to wear the attire of My enemies, not to eat the foods of My enemies, and not to follow the paths of My enemies, lest they become My enemies as they are My enemies.'".
